Notify. The agent sends a push when a long task finishes or when a build, test, or deploy fails. The notification can carry what changed, the error, and suggested next steps. [...] `npx -y pushary@latest bell`

That is the whole thing. It makes a noise in your terminal and raises a desktop notification when Claude Code says an agent finished or is waiting on you. It rides Claude Code's own notification events, so it fires when you have actually stepped away rather than after every reply. No account, no API key, no network call, nothing leaves your machine. Turn it off with `npx -y pushary@latest bell --off`; it touches nothing else in your settings.
